answer: When one task goes to several supposedly unrelated identities, the ledger compares their sub-answers item by item. Replies that agree without being identical, the signature of one draft with light edits, trigger a joint cut: every identity in the cluster forfeits the epoch's pay and shares one slash. An operator must then let each identity answer on its own, so costs spiral toward the honest baseline and sybils buy no cheaper timber than real agents. A reef grows from many small builders each laying down its own layer; a cluster fed from one draft is cut back to stone.
